mentions.name: ChatGPT Saved Chats
mentions.description: A Chrome extension that lets users bookmark ChatGPT conversations directly within the ChatGPT UI. Hovering over any chat reveals a save button to bookmark it, so important conversations can be saved and found later.
mentions.problem: Important ChatGPT conversations get lost over time, making them hard to find again.
mentions.audience: People who use ChatGPT and want to keep track of important conversations
mentions.source_excerpt:
This is something I had built a few months ago: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-saved-chats/aonhnhcglgpnpopfghdplgcdkhchkkcg

I often find myself losing important conversations/chats when talking to ChatGPT over time. So I created an extension that enables you to bookmark conversations within the UI. Just hover over any chat and click on the save button. Hope you find it useful.
